Same-QA issue-only rebind: **evidence-incomplete**, superseding [the previous verdict](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/439#issuecomment-6031898060). Issue438 now passes the fixed five-section communication check: only the stale operational status tail was removed; requirements, plan, owner and links are unchanged. The original issue body is preserved exactly.

**Native chooser proof remains the only outstanding gate; no applicable waiver exists.** Source, PR body, configured review, CI and retained evidence remain unchanged. Existing tests/captures were reused; prior receipts and the explicit encoding correction remain preserved.

[Immutable superseding assessment and exact bindings](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/bf82d9f38c8a488720ee0e97b1b2f59c97d464a6/pr439-qa/issue-rebind-20261007/verdict.json). No source, readiness or draft mutations.
